description: Commencement of new projects for the development of infrastructure facilities in State Universities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The Department of National Planning has recommended 16 project proposals submitted for the development of infrastructure facilities in state universities falling under the purview of the Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education and included in the Public Investment Plan 2026-2030 for implementation. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education to implement the following projects during the period 2026-2030, with the objectives of improving the infrastructure facilities of universities to accommodate the academic activities of university students and to suit the courses they are pursuing and bringing state universities to the level of international universities, was approved by the Cabinet.

Constructing, completing and equipping of a Professorial Unit for the Faculty of Medicine, University of Moratuwa - Estimated Project Cost Rs.3,594.14 million.
Providing hostel facilities for university students - Estimated Project Cost Rs.26,625 million.
Renovation of hostels at the University of Peradeniya - Estimated Project Cost Rs.2,452 million.
Construction of a sewerage treatment plant for hostels at the University of Vauniya - Estimated Project Cost Rs.219 million.
Construction and completion of the proposed building for the Faculty of Business Studies, University of Moratuwa - Estimated Project Cost Rs.1309.42 million.
Construction of a multipurpose building for the Faculty of Dental Sciences and the Faculty of Allied Health Sciences of the University of Sri Jayewardenepura - Estimated Project Cost Rs.3,419.38 million.
Expansion of the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering Building to house the proposed Heavy Structures Engineering Laboratory and Coastal and Port Engineering Laboratory for the Faculty of Engineering, University of Ruhuna - Estimated Project Cost Rs.1,453.97 million.
Construction of a Professorial Unit for the Faculty of Health Care Sciences of the Eastern University at the Teaching Hospital, Batticaloa - Estimated Project Cost Rs.2,279 million.
Upgrading the Canteen of the Faculty of Applied Sciences, University of Vauniya - Estimated Project Cost Rs.64 million.
Extension of the Student Canteen Complex of the Faculty of Dental Science, University of Peradeniya - Estimated Project Cost Rs.100 million.
Construction of a Health Center at the University of Vavuniya - Estimated Project Cost Rs.45 million.
Construction of a two-storied building for the University of Vauniya - Estimated project cost Rs.474 million.
Construction of a building with laboratories, workshops and lecture halls for the Faculty of Technology Studies of the University of Uwa Wellassa - Estimated project cost Rs.649.80 million.
Construction of a laboratory complex for the Faculty of Allied Health Sciences of the University of Peradeniya - Estimated project cost Rs.405 million.
Construction of a laboratory complex for the Faculty of Agriculture of the University of Ruhuna - Estimated project cost Rs.2,342 million.
Construction of a six-storied building for the Faculty of Management Studies of the Open University of Sri Lanka - Estimated project cost Rs.885.80 million.
